# temporal-calendar

> A lightweight utility library for building calendar UIs with the Temporal API.

temporal-calendar provides type-safe calendar building blocks using the modern Temporal API. It supports month, week, and day views with timezone awareness, DST-safe operations, an item-agnostic controller, and locally inferred view projections.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs): Overview of temporal-calendar and key features
- [Core Installation](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/core/installation): Getting started with @gobrand/calendar-core
- [React Installation](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/installation): Getting started with @gobrand/react-calendar

## React

- [Installation](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/installation): Get started with GoBrand React Calendar
- [Your first calendar](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/first-calendar): Build a navigable month from ordinary values and inferred item types.
- [Data and Suspense](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/data-and-suspense): Keep controls interactive while each calendar view owns its query and item type.
- [Timezones and visible ranges](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/timezones-and-ranges): Query half-open calendar ranges that remain correct across DST transitions.
- [Controlled state and routing](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/controlled-state): Synchronize calendar date and view with URLs or external application state.

### Api

- [useCreateCalendar](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/api/use-create-calendar): Create a controlled or uncontrolled item-agnostic controller, with optional simple-mode data.
- [useCalendar](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/api/use-calendar): Read the item-agnostic calendar controller from context.
- [useCalendarView](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/api/use-calendar-view): Project view-local data through the item-agnostic calendar controller.
- [CalendarProvider](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/api/calendar-provider): Share an item-agnostic controller with controls and view projections.

### Types

- [Calendar Controller](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/types/calendar): Item-agnostic calendar state, navigation, and visible query range.
- [View Models](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/types/views): Discriminated month, week, and day models with locally inferred items.
- [Range and Configuration Types](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/types/helpers): Public types for configured views, geometry, and half-open query ranges.

### Examples

- [Month View](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/examples/basic-month): Build a month calendar with data fetching
- [Week View](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/examples/week-view): 
- [Day View](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/examples/day-view): Build a day calendar with hourly time slots
- [Multi-View Calendar](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/react/examples/multi-view): Switch between month, week, and day views

## Core

- [Installation](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/core/installation): Get started with GoBrand Calendar Core
- [createCalendar](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/core/create-calendar): Create an item-agnostic controller from a non-empty view configuration.
- [View Projections](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/core/projections): Build month, week, and day models from controller state and local data.
- [Visible ranges](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/core/visible-ranges): Understand Calendar's timezone-aware, half-open query boundary.
- [Utilities](https://eng.gobrand.app/calendar/docs/core/utilities): Formatting, navigation, and timezone helpers
